title: Questions to Ask Your Doctor About GLP-1 Medications

authorship.recommended_normalized_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team

primary_question: What questions should I ask my healthcare provider before starting a GLP-1 medication?
reader_intent: Prepare for a productive, informed provider conversation about GLP-1 medications.
desired_reader_outcome: Reader arrives at a provider visit with a concrete, comprehensive question list covering candidacy, alternatives, monitoring, side effects, long-term planning, interactions, and cost.

internal_link_recommendations.reason: Understanding the mechanism first can make the provider-question list more meaningful.
A reader preparing questions should also understand the FDA-approved-vs-compounded distinction before the appointment.

disposition_reason: A pure, well-structured question framework that asserts no specific clinical/statistical/mechanistic facts of its own — there is nothing here to be unsupported, outdated, or overbroad. Genuinely useful, distinct from the other two GLP-1 articles by reader job (appointment preparation, not mechanism or medication-type education), and requires only trivial editing.
